# NFL Daily — 2026-08-10 (Past 1 day)

## Summary
- 08/10: Cowboys signed DT Quinnen Williams to a 3-year, $105.9M extension, the largest third contract ever for a DL. [ESPN](https://www.espn.com/nfl/story/_/id/49577284/sources-cowboys-quinnen-williams-reach-3-year-1059m-deal) — also [RapSheet](https://x.com/RapSheet/status/2086917280211046508)
- 08/10: Patriots signed TE Hunter Henry to a 2-year extension worth up to $20M ($14.5M guaranteed). [ESPN](https://www.espn.com/nfl/story/_/id/49574198/sources-patriots-te-hunter-henry-agree-2-year-extension) — also [Schefter](https://x.com/AdamSchefter/status/2086790025719468455)
- 08/10: Commanders LT Laremy Tunsil will have surgery on a torn triceps and is expected to miss most or all of the season; Brandon Coleman takes over at LT. [ESPN](https://www.espn.com/nfl/story/_/id/49574125/commanders-star-lt-laremy-tunsil-triceps-surgery) — also [Schefter](https://x.com/AdamSchefter/status/2086785134364086654)
- 08/10: Lions lost starting C Cade Mays (fractured wrist, out ~8-10 weeks) and RB Isiah Pacheco (sprained MCL, expected back for the opener) to injuries. [ESPN](https://www.espn.com/nfl/story/_/id/49574921/lions-cade-mays-wrist-expected-miss-8-10-weeks) — also [RapSheet](https://x.com/RapSheet/status/2086821790958199034)
- 08/10: NFL will allow head coaches to designate a staff member to initiate replay challenges. [ESPN](https://www.espn.com/nfl/story/_/id/49575837/nfl-allow-coach-designee-initiate-replay-challenges)
- 08/10: Chiefs OC Eric Bieniemy returned to the team after a two-week absence following the shooting of his wife, Mia. [ESPN](https://www.espn.com/nfl/story/_/id/49574977/oc-eric-bieniemy-returns-chiefs-shooting-wife)
- 08/10: 49ers RB Christian McCaffrey sat out practice with "tightness"; team says it's not concerned. [NYT Athletic](https://www.nytimes.com/athletic/7504308/2026/08/10/christian-mccaffrey-injury-49ers-training-camp/)
- 08/10: Teddy Bridgewater confirmed his retirement is official. [RapSheet](https://x.com/RapSheet/status/2086913278299820269)
